units.name: Conversation Turn Lifecycle
units.description: How one inbound user message becomes one outbound reply: history is loaded and compacted, a parked approval is picked up, the agent runs, and exactly one reply is dispatched to the surface before the turn is committed or the history invalidated. Start at src/conciergent/turn.py and src/conciergent/runtime.py, then tests/test_runtime.py and tests/test_reply.py.

units.name: Conversation Memory and Compaction
units.description: Per-conversation history and short-lived turn state kept in Redis, with turn caps, TTL expiry, and summarization of older turns once the model context window nears its limit. Start at src/conciergent/store/message.py and src/conciergent/agent/compactor.py, then tests/store/.

units.name: Agent Run and MCP Tool Access
units.description: The AI agent that answers a turn: model configuration, layered instructions, the structured-output contract, and the MCP toolsets it dials, including specs served in-process by the embedded openapi-mcp-gateway. Start at src/conciergent/agent/runner.py and src/conciergent/agent/mcp/client.py, plus the gateway assembly in src/conciergent/app.py and tests/agent/.

units.name: Destructive-Tool Approval Gate
units.description: Human-in-the-loop confirmation: a tool the MCP server marks destructive pauses behind a Confirm / Cancel card, its in-flight state is parked with a TTL, and the user's confirm, cancel, or topic change resumes or drops the deferred call. Start at the approval predicate in src/conciergent/agent/mcp/client.py, the park/resume paths in src/conciergent/agent/runner.py, and PendingApproval in src/conciergent/runtime.py.

units.name: In-Chat OAuth Authorization and Sign-Out
units.description: Per-user authorization to an MCP server carried out inside the conversation: the authorize link is rendered in chat, the callback delivers the code back through the store, tokens and client registrations are persisted and refreshed, and a sign-out revokes them. Start at the bridges in src/conciergent/runtime.py, src/conciergent/agent/mcp/storage.py, src/conciergent/store/credential.py, the callback route in src/conciergent/app.py, and tests/test_oauth_handoff.py.

units.name: Structured Reply Model and Rendering
units.description: The surface-neutral reply model (plain text, Card, Carousel, links, suggestions) and its native rendering per platform, including localized UI strings and the per-surface formatting dialect fed to the agent. Start at src/conciergent/reply.py, src/conciergent/surfaces/base.py, src/conciergent/surfaces/*/render.py, and src/conciergent/i18n/.

units.name: Chat Surface Ingress and User Identity
units.description: How Slack, LINE, and Discord deliver events and how a platform user becomes a stable principal: signature verification, event dedupe, webhook versus persistent-gateway delivery, suggestion button callbacks, Slack workspace install with bot-token lookup, and per-user language resolution. Start at src/conciergent/surfaces/{slack,line,discord}/ (webhook.py, gateway.py, surface.py, install.py), src/conciergent/identity.py, and tests/surfaces/.

units.name: Application Configuration and Assembly
units.description: The single-YAML, no-code setup path: layered defaults and ${ENV_VAR} config, which surfaces and stores are enabled, scaffolding and serving via the CLI, process logging, and the health endpoint. Start at src/conciergent/config.py, src/conciergent/defaults.py, src/conciergent/cli.py, src/conciergent/app.py, src/conciergent/logger.py, and examples/.
